title: docs(design): Studio test-pass evidence screenshots for the sixteen queue cards (2026-10-15)
body:
## What

Thirty-four screenshots from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass, under `docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/2026-10-15/`, with a README that maps each file to the objectui card it is evidence for: #12506, #12507, #12509, #12510, #12511, #12512, #12513, #12514, #12515, #12516, #12517, #12519, #12522, #12524, #12531. Each card's body gets an Evidence section pointing at its files once this lands.

## Why

The cards describe what was measured in words and numbers; the maintainer asked for the pictures beside them (「你报的界面问题不需要带上截图吗？」). GitHub has no API for a bot to attach images to an issue, so the pictures live in the repository next to the reference artboards, as objectstack-ai/objectui#12458 did for the artboards.

## Scope

Documentation only: one folder of JPEG files and one README. Nothing imports the folder, no build reads it, no package source changes, hence `skip-changeset`.

Part of objectstack-ai/objectui#12446.
